resources.string: A small gesture. A useful action.
Make two short chopping motions in opposite directions while holding the phone firmly.
Tap the back of the phone. Calibrate for your phone and case first.
Turn the phone from face up to face down and hold it steady.
Press the selected volume button or combination twice. Requires accessibility access. Screen-off behavior depends on the device. Normal volume changes remain active.
Action unavailable. Check permissions and gesture settings.
The gesture will be removed from Home. You can add it again.
Perform the gesture. Actions are paused during this test.
Hold the phone still. Tap the back five times, about one second apart.
With accessibility access on, the app opens right away. Otherwise a notification appears: tap it to open the app.

Tukk uses accessibility access only for volume buttons, the screenshot command and opening the chosen app after a gesture. It does not read screen content or send data. Access is optional and can be disabled in system settings.
To change silent, vibrate and sound modes with a gesture, allow Tukk to control Do Not Disturb.
Assign actions to movements and buttons. Start with the flashlight, adjust sensitivity and test your gesture. All settings stay on your phone.
Allow notifications in Tukk system settings to enable background operation.
Sensor recording lasts up to 15 seconds and stays on this device.
Repeat the gesture to return to normal sound.
To turn this gesture on, grant the access it needs or choose an app below.
The system may stop Tukk in the background. Allow unrestricted battery use.
Tukk can run in the background without restrictions.
Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO: turn on Autostart, set Battery saver to No restrictions and lock Tukk in the recent apps list.
Samsung: in Device care → Battery → Background usage limits, remove Tukk from the sleeping app lists and add it to Never sleeping apps.
Huawei, Honor: in Battery → App launch, turn off automatic management for Tukk and allow auto-launch and running in the background.
OnePlus, OPPO, realme: in the app battery settings, allow background activity and auto-launch.
